cell_line: The type I strain RHΔHx, referred to here as RH, maintained by sequential passages through in vitro culture, and used it to obtain MOB1 recombinant protein-expressing strains.
cell_type: Toxoplasma gondii tachyzoites were cultured using DMEM GlutaMAX, supplemented with 1% FBS.
material_type: Toxoplasma gondii tachyzoites were transfected by electroporation using program U-033 of the Nucleofector™ 2b and the Amaxa® Basic Parasite Nucleofector Kit 2 (Lonza, Basel, Switzerland).
sample_source: We analyzed the type I strain RHΔHx, referred to here as RH, maintained by sequential passages through in vitro culture, and used it to obtain MOB1 recombinant protein-expressing strains.
species: Toxoplasma gondii is a unicellular parasitic eukaryotic organism that presents a highly polarized cell and an obligatory intracellular lifestyle during most of its life cycle.
strain: We analyzed the type I strain RHΔHx, referred to here as RH, maintained by sequential passages through in vitro culture, and used it to obtain MOB1 recombinant protein-expressing strains.
